'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
****[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] appears to confirm ordering a major cross-border operation inside Russia, saying that "Russia brought war to our land, and it should feel what it has done". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy0ngzg9754o (BBC News)]
****Large explosions are reported near the town of [[Rylsk, Russia|Rylsk]] in [[Kursk Oblast]], [[Russia]], with videos on [[social media]] appearing to show a destroyed column of military vehicles. [https://kyivindependent.com/mass-fires-reported-in-rylsk-in-kursk-oblast/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
****[[Ukraine]] launches twelve rockets and 14 drones into Russia, according to both acting [[Governor of Kursk Oblast]] [[Alexei Smirnov (politician)|Alexei Smirnov]] and the [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defence]]. [https://www.dw.com/ru/na-kurskuu-belgorodskuu-i-orlovskuu-oblasti-soversena-novaa-ataka-dronov/a-69883582 (DW Russian)]
****[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] capture dozens of [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian soldiers]] in their offensive in Kursk Oblast. Russian authorities say that fighting is still ongoing for control of several settlements near [[Russia–Ukraine border|the border]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/program/newsfeed/2024/8/8/ukraine-captures-dozens-of-russian-soldiers-during-kursk-incursion (Al Jazeera)]
****Ukrainian troops and tanks enter the town of [[Sudzha]], forcing the local residents to flee. [https://news.sky.com/story/unprecedented-ukrainian-incursion-into-russia-signals-new-type-of-attack-13193318 (Sky News)] [https://www.bbc.com/russian/articles/cm2n4qg4zdgo (BBC Russian Service)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**One [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] civilian and a [[Hezbollah]] militant are killed and three Lebanese civilians are injured in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] strikes in [[southern Lebanon]]. 
**Hezbollah fires 25 rockets at the Israeli-occupied [[Syria]]n [[Golan Heights]] and fifteen rockets at [[Shlomi, Israel|Shlomi]] and [[Kabri, Israel|Kabri]] in [[Upper Galilee]], [[Israel]]. All rockets are intercepted by the [[Iron Dome]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/8/israels-war-on-gaza-live-victims-burn-as-tents-bombed-in-khan-younis/ (Al Jazeera)]  

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Debby (2024)|Hurricane Debby]]
***Tropical Storm Debby makes its second [[landfall]] near [[Bulls Bay Light|Bulls Bay]], [[South Carolina]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/hurricane-tropical-storm-debby-flooding-d90428b0417df35fa1cae8b24793f5c5 (AP)]
*[[2024 Hyūga-nada earthquake]]
**A [[Richter Scale|7.1-magnitude]] [[earthquake]] strikes off the coast of [[Kyushu]], [[Japan]]. A [[tsunami]] advisory is issued for parts of the islands of Kyushu and [[Shikoku]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2024/08/08/japan/japan-kyushu-quake/ (''The Japan Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement]]
**[[Non-cooperation movement (2024)|Non-cooperation movement]]
***[[Muhammad Yunus]] returns to [[Bangladesh]] to lead the country's [[2024 Bangladesh interim government|interim government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/bangladesh-awaits-installation-interim-government-after-weeks-strife-2024-08-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[2017–2018 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**Former [[President of the Government of Catalonia|Catalan government president]] [[Carles Puigdemont]] returns to [[Barcelona]], [[Spain]],  after seven years of "self-exile", defying an arrest warrant issued by the [[Supreme Court of Spain|Supreme Court]]. [[Catalonia|Catalan]] [[Mossos d'Esquadra|regional police]] subsequently institute tight controls on traffic in and out of the city, as part of an attempt to arrest Puigdemont. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/08/08/world/europe/carles-puigdemont-catalonia-spain.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://cadenaser.com/nacional/2024/08/08/los-mossos-activan-la-operacion-jaula-para-detener-a-carles-puigdemont-que-sigue-en-paradero-desconocido-tras-su-mitin-cadena-ser/ (Cadena SER)] 
**Two [[Mossos d'Esquadra]] officers are arrested for allegedly collaborating on Puigdemont's escape, following his public appearance in Barcelona. [https://www.antena3.com/noticias/espana/detienen-mosso-acusado-colaborar-huida-puigdemont-aparecer-barcelona_2024080866b4a40776ed0d00012ad493.html (Antena 3)]
*[[2024 Catalan regional election]]
**[[Socialists' Party of Catalonia|Socialists' Party]] candidate [[Salvador Illa]] is elected as the new [[President of the Government of Catalonia|Catalan government president]] by the [[Parliament of Catalonia]], becoming the first non-[[Catalan independence movement|separatist]] president in more than 10 years. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/8/socialist-salvador-illa-elected-leader-of-spains-catalonia (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Internet censorship in Russia]]
**[[YouTube]] is reportedly blocked and slowed down across [[Russia]] following the website's blocking of several channels that expressed support for the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/youtube-video-blocked-russia/33070407.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Summer Olympics]]
**[[Botswana at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Letsile Tebogo]] wins the gold medal in [[Athletics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's 200 metres|Men's 200 metres]], earning [[Botswana]] its [[Botswana at the Olympics|first ever]] gold medal. [https://olympics.com/en/news/letsile-tebogo-stuns-noah-lyles-to-win-mens-200m-gold (Olympics)]
**[[Ecuador at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Lucía Yépez]] wins the silver medal in the [[Wrestling at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's freestyle 53 kg|Women's freestyle 53 kg wrestling]] event, the first medal in the [[Wrestling at the 2024 Summer Olympics|sport]] for [[Ecuador]]. [https://olympics.com/en/news/paris-2024-wrestling-japan-fujinami-akari-53kg-freestyle-gold (Olympics)]
**[[Pakistan at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Arshad Nadeem]] wins the gold medal in [[Athletics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's javelin throw|Men's javelin throw]], breaking the [[List of Olympic records in athletics|Olympic record]] and earning [[Pakistan]] its [[Pakistan at the Olympics|first ever]] medal in [[Athletics at the 2024 Summer Olympics|Athletics]] and its first ever individual gold medal. [https://www.dw.com/en/olympics-arshad-nadeem-wins-javelin-gold-after-record-throw/a-69894346 (DW)]
**[[Refugee Olympic Team at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Cindy Ngamba]] wins a bronze medal in [[Boxing at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's 75 kg|Women's middleweight boxing]], the first-ever medal won for the [[Refugee Olympic Team at the Olympics|Refugee Olympic Team]]. [https://olympics.com/en/news/paris-2024-boxing-women-bronze-75kg-ngamba-parker (Olympics)]
